notes.title: Dev Log - Sept 23
notes.content:
[p]To all aspiring scholars,[/p][p align="start"]I’ve noticed many of you are curious about the progress of our playtest version. Lately, we’ve been fully focused on optimization and bug fixes, and today I’d like to share a glimpse of our daily development life.[/p][p align="start"]Yesterday, while passing by our artist’s desk, I was stunned to see a character wearing black stockings on their screen—I nearly dropped my jaw.
[i]Can our Warring States era really have black stockings? Really?[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/ecd6d92be284804b33f055a46c0ea0c15b5bc7c7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/121f02de4b66e08860f03f0021e6e0abb5abdc94.jpg"][/img]The artist wiped the drool off their face (just kidding) and explained that the stockings disappeared after adjusting the lighting. They’re considering adding it as a visual toggle in the settings.
That reminded me: our dialogue interface has had a similar lighting issue all along.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/e6001510849a7fd6eed8d2900f45442a8734d23b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/dcfbf5703b5e39c88e1355ee901be408ad5c330a.png"][/img]So I assigned an urgent task to readjust the lighting—and finally, we can see characters’ faces clearly in dialogues now.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]But beyond these visible bugs, the biggest challenge lies in optimization.
Although screenshots might suggest the system can handle 1,000 soldiers on screen at 90-120 FPS…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/b1dcd32cbb2b27d3a2dde3555f6b60570c88d20a.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The originally designed AI was too realistic: each soldier calculates attack paths and actions based on distance and status, even including behaviors like fleeing or ganging up. But when they all interact simultaneously, the CPU simply can’t keep up.
The calculations consume massive resources, leading to high CPU usage—when computation can’t match the refresh rate, the game stutters noticeably.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/3ea1fc1c7b93cd964c89b88dd50183119b819ec5.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Besides combat, overworld optimization is another major hurdle.[/p][p align="start"]After capturing Wuyang County, I chose to plunder it—leaving the city starved and depleted. Merchants rushed to neighboring counties for goods, causing prices to skyrocket. These wealthy merchants then attracted bandits, and after local rebels were wiped out, the common people ended up worse off than before, with caravans frantically fleeing in all directions.[/p][p align="start"]If this happened during a full-scale war between two states, hundreds of caravans and thousands of bandits could spawn at once, spreading across the entire map. Just imagining it makes me smell something burning… and it’s not my lunch.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/01662d631a9d0bd2fc433d258cf68cee851ba391.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The most effective optimization method? [b]Cutting corners[/b].
Soldiers off-screen won’t use full AI—they’ll simply charge forward and retreat when injured.
When a city runs low on supplies, goods will be magically “imported” instead of simulating real logistics.
The number of movable units on the overworld will be limited to two counties at a time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/5dbc3590deaeea130c1479f66aa3d9f9033f4ce1.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]We’ve invested heavily in enriching the freedom of this open-world experience, but to solve these issues in a short time, we’ve had to sacrifice some content that still needs polishing.[/p][p align="start"]Even after aggressive optimization, we still have concerns about the current version’s stability and depth. We can’t in good conscience release it in this state. Therefore, we’ve decided to delay the playtest to November 15.[/p][p align="start"]To those eagerly looking forward to playing during the National Day holiday—we sincerely apologize and hope for your understanding.
Our team will continue battling stubborn bugs throughout the holiday, ensuring the November build delivers more playable content.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]— Xiao Xi & Qin Shi Huang[/p]

notes.title: We've received all the feedback everyone shared last week, but...
notes.content:
[p]Once again (and again and again), we've made it through another half-year development phase, and a new playtest is just around the corner. Thank you all for enthusiastically participating in our testing recruitment event.[/p][p]
Last week’s activity with the highest participation turned out to be the questionnaire feedback!
[url="https://han-office-cd.feishu.cn/share/base/form/shrcncZ4oksnTPPDGLVmaioNtEd"]Huaxia: Warring States Nine Provinces Warriors Positioning Test[/url][/p][p align="start"]Everyone offered many suggestions in the questionnaire, some even delving into detailed explanations of their understanding of move skills and build styles.[/p][p align="start"]My personal favorite suggestion was [b]"idol movement and voice optimizations for professions."[/b] At first, I almost thought a dedicated fan had wandered into the wrong place—turns out it was about "idle animations," not "idols"![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/bf6644596bb8fe87736de8b950210cba51fc337f.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Our 3D characters are already full of life, and right now, we’re handcrafting detailed animations to equip these "idols" with.
Not only that, but the highly anticipated character customization feature is also in the works. Here’s a handsome guy I created:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/362e730ce8958114b752fc432117db79f445383e.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Just kidding—he’s much cooler in-game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/e8e1eeba6e90f57e5c7650197108eca6cbd36ff4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/882979c66867ef4edf2fbd08bf9d072f33375e8a.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]It seems everyone still enjoys playing dress-up games, huh?[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/d596107b072f7104af980164a6a35a1efa7d3002.png"][/img]Most of our scholars in the Nine Provinces are honorable individuals—underhanded schemes are better left to the likes of Skyrim.
As the First Emperor, I don’t need deceit—unifying Huaxia was a matter of a single command.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/f6026d6ba746dc10d00862e30e274f40f8cb24cf.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/fbe2e986fa1bb8b782ce224feaa93299cabfd75b.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Our international friends remain big fans of Chinese martial arts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/a13dc5f7c57014838b3ae795d17f2003f744d912.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/e8431441133d919102be9de9ede29adc40ee9478.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"]Many also mentioned hoping for a strong, distinctive connection between the Nine Schools of Thought and the Seven States—this is exactly the kind of highlight we want [i][b]Huaxia: Warring States[/b][/i] to embody.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/7c70fc5ead509b96248c161a867fc67920c374da.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]You can recruit talented individuals from across the land to strengthen your influence, or use people with conflicting loyalties to create checks and balances...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/7fdd4e5ea010e75d9df60803c18590fc91d060a5.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]We’ll also provide recommended configurations to ensure the game remains challenging without becoming overly difficult.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/4845e897547601214c5e6f2bdaeaec72966287d6.png"][/img]A huge thank you to everyone who took the time to fill out the questionnaire and send us your encouraging feedback! More events will be rolled out in the future, so make sure to join our QQ group—your chances of winning giveaways are much higher there![/p][p align="start"]While we couldn’t address every single suggestion in this post, please know that we’re carefully reviewing all of them!
If you have more ideas, feel free to share them openly in the group. And don’t forget to stay active there to nudge us for updates—we’re waiting for you every day![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/X8Vqud4JPy"]Join our Discord[/url][/p]

[h2]Playtest Time:[/h2]

[b] Recruitment: January 17 - January 19, 2024
    Test Period: January 20 - January 27, 2024
    Platform: PC (Steam)[/b]
[b]
[h2]What's in the test:[/h2][/b]

In this closed beta, you will be able to experience the following brand new content:

    [b]New character creation system: [/b]customize your character and shape your own hero!
    [b]Yuzhou tour experience:[/b] immersive experience of Yuzhou's unique history and culture.
    [b]Basic Squad Building Gameplay:[/b] Form your own squad and challenge your enemies!
    [b]Initial Guided Plot:[/b] Start an exciting adventure and explore the mysteries of the Warring States.

notes.title: Huaxia: Warring States X Chinajoy ! Open the new demo online synchronously!
notes.content:
After last month's Next Festival, we made significant optimizations to the game based on feedback and suggestions from players!
We have resolved the issues of archiving and resolution adaptation that everyone mentioned, made significant modifications to the UI, reduced performance consumption, and comprehensively upgraded the visual performance.
In addition to these optimized contents, we have also added new gameplay such as a crime system and a member management system. We have also added many plot tasks and other exploratory content for each county in the open area of this trial version. Come and experience it again!

This trial will be open at 8pm Beijing time on July 25th!

The following are the specific updates for this demo version:
1. The first level scene of Kyushu has been reset, and now Kyushu will be completed as a whole to adapt to subsequent national operations and strategic gameplay.
2. The first level scene art style has been updated, and the current style better reflects the style of Kyushu.
3. The scale and design of all secondary scenes have been reset, and now the scenes better match the positioning and gaming experience of each area.
4. Updated the secondary scene commercial area, soldier area, city gate area, fiefdom, county and township, and optimized the art style.
5. The archiving function has been updated, and now the official archiving system can be used.
6. Revised the teams in the Yuzhou scene, adding richness in team types and differences in team combat abilities.
7. Updated the dynamic placement of character health bar positions to match creatures of different body types.
8. Revised the data of combat units to make the numerical differences between each combat unit more apparent.
9. Revised the route for upgrading followers and added prop requirements to reflect the differences in the route for upgrading followers.
10. The team's numerical rules have been adjusted, and now the numerical values of all hero characters in the team will affect the team's maximum number of followers, maximum number of prisoners, and movement speed.
11. The Hu Cong store interface has been reset, making it easier to purchase and operate now.
12. Added rules for handling prisoners of war, now allowing for related operations on hero characters and ordinary units of prisoners of war.
13. Added a quick access function to the location, now you can select the desired character and related functions to visit on the first level scene interface, and directly reach their location.
14. A new criminal system has been added, and now each faction will independently evaluate the degree of crime of their characters, assess and take measures against the criminal behavior of different characters.
15. Revised the details of crime and prison gameplay, and implemented the overall logic of crime and escape gameplay.
16. The member management system has been updated, allowing for the management and cultivation of collected hero characters.
17. Updated hero AI behavior, adding various manifestations of AI in daily behavior.
18. The game time system has been reset, and now only the first level scene time will automatically pass. In other scenes, time will become an action resource.
19. Updated the plot tasks and performances of Yuzhou, and implemented the game plot and tasks within Sanchuan County.
20. Optimized the output mode of the role model, reducing the lag problem caused by too many roles.
21. Optimized the scene model and reduced stuttering issues within the scene.
22. Revised overall interface issues and updated some unreasonable interfaces.

At present, our game already supports English, but it is still in the development stage and does not represent the final translation quality. 
We will also continue to address in-game issures and improve performance optimization next week.
Please add a wishlist to support us！Thank you！

notes.title: 《Age of HuaXia:Warring States》Demo first update！
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370144/7d2917e8d8c2585137142183984e4da5b36b5c97.jpg[/img]
6/1版本更新内容

再次感谢大家的积极反馈！
我们将在这段时间持续修复游戏问题，优化体验，以及添加更多的游戏内容！
还请大家保持关注！


-修复了以下问题：

·队伍扈从升级模型报错
·场景中角色重新加载模型报错
·休息到临界状态值时无限跳转
·大世界中队伍追击距离过远
·食物叠加上限过少
·行商小队不能正确出现
·封邑通行权导致国人不能正常进入房屋等场景


-增加了部分新内容以及优化了部分玩法的体验：

任务：

·支线任务增加使对应交互可进行的特性（论道、切磋、求教）
·修正部分任务文本内容
·问剑任务流程优化
世界：

·在野外增加行商小队，可与各类商人交互购买物品
·减少野外黑市捕奴队的数量
·调整杂货商的商品内容，增加护甲维修道具，增加食物
·调整武器商人的商品内容，增加白色品质武器
·调整野外队伍追击参数，降低野外队伍追击移动速度
·增加部分场景首次进入时的演绎：城门守卫（调整）、商业区

宗族封邑：

·修正巩县封邑错误的NPC位置
·修正巩县封邑场景对国人身份的限制，不再阻止国人玩家进入建筑
·增加巩县封邑庄园中的任务交互物
·增加了巩县封邑场景内的奴人英雄

交互：

·新增了一些UI音效
·优化说服离开房间的名称和功能描述
·开放国人身份招揽其他英雄为队友的交互

数值：
·取消违禁品设定， 避免玩家触发被没收背包的流程
·负重等级为低时的野外旅行饱食度消耗降低
·修正脱离奴人奖励获得的衣物可能导致界面崩溃的问题
·修正修理工具道具的负重值、好感度价值
·提高了钱币的好感度价值
